todos.name: OUTLOOK_* env for live send-brief
todos.notes: Oldest open P0 (2026-07-28). Live user-facing feature broken.
todos.howTo: Create an Outlook SMTP app password, add OUTLOOK_EMAIL and OUTLOOK_APP_PASSWORD to the Vercel project environment, redeploy, and send a test brief through the live form.

todos.name: Rotate NOTION_TOKEN + confirm Comb Vercel env
todos.blockedOn: User rotates Notion token; confirm COMB_USER/PASSWORD
todos.notes: C1/C2 — token may have been pasted in chat.
todos.howTo: Revoke the old Notion integration token in Notion settings, create a new integration, share the HIVE databases with it, paste the new token into Vercel env, and verify the Comb live fetch works.

todos.name: Move Anialah .env out of OneDrive
todos.notes: Moved to %USERPROFILE%\.anialah\.env (+ jarvis.env); ani_config loads local-only path. Done 2026-08-07.
todos.howTo: Move any .env files from the Anialah OneDrive folder to a local-only secrets directory outside sync, update the app config to read from the new path, and rotate any exposed credentials.

todos.name: vercel login + redeploy Comb
todos.notes: Local master ahead of live; deploy blocked without auth.
todos.howTo: Run vercel login in the Cursor terminal, select the HIVE Comb project, deploy the current branch, and verify the live URL shows the updated shell.

todos.name: Compliance Club Vercel secrets (PayFast/Anthropic/email)
todos.notes: Payments, AI chat, and mail dead without secrets.
todos.howTo: Add the PayFast merchant key, Anthropic API key, and SMTP credentials to the Vercel environment for the compliance-club project, then redeploy and run a checkout + chat + mail smoke test.

todos.name: Club CTA button on marketing site (partner Firebase deploy)
todos.howTo: Confirm the partner pushed main@4411c32 to Firebase hosting, then open praeto.co.za and verify the club CTA button navigates to the signup flow.

todos.name: Legal opinion for Balance mobile
todos.howTo: Brief external counsel on gambling-harm and financial data handling, request a written go/no-go opinion, and decide whether to launch Balance mobile.

todos.name: Hosting decision for PABOS + Balance API
todos.blockedOn: User picks Render vs Fly vs self-managed
todos.notes: Both products should not drift hosts without a reason.
todos.howTo: Compare Render, Fly, and self-managed options on price, deploy DX, and South African latency, pick one host for both services, and document the decision.

todos.name: Name a Tiespro restore source
todos.blockedOn: User confirms restore source or write-off
todos.notes: Agent can check GitHub; user owns search of archives.
todos.howTo: Search local archives, old GitHub repositories, and backup drives for Tiespro source code; if nothing is found, confirm with the user that the project is written off.

todos.name: Real SMTP provider for PABOS
todos.howTo: Sign up for Postmark, AWS SES, or Resend, verify the sending domain, create an API key, add it to the PABOS environment, and send a test transactional email.

todos.name: Put Balance mobile under git
todos.howTo: Initialize a git repository in the praeto-balance-app folder, create a GitHub remote, push the initial commit, and verify .gitignore excludes secrets and build artifacts.

todos.name: Push Comb to GitHub
todos.howTo: Create a GitHub repository for the Comb, add it as a remote, push the current cursor/comb-deep-hive and master branches, and set the default branch.

todos.name: Decide quote-endpoint destination (praeto.co.za)
todos.howTo: Choose whether quote submissions go to an email inbox, CRM, or PABOS API endpoint, update the form action, and test the full submission flow.

todos.name: Club auth-download verify (Foundation+ manual)
todos.blockedOn: User login + download smoke after merge
todos.howTo: Log in to the live compliance-club site, navigate to the Foundation+ manual, click download, and verify the 01_FSP_Compliance_Manual.docx file opens correctly.

todos.name: VAPID keys + Google Play verification (Stella Indoor)
todos.howTo: Generate a VAPID key pair, add the public and private keys to the Stella web app and server, and complete Google Play identity verification for push notifications.

todos.name: Retry Balance folder rename off ugly path
todos.blockedOn: OneDrive Access denied — User closes locks + renames
todos.howTo: Close any OneDrive locks on the praeto-balance-app_2 (1) folder, rename it to praeto-balance-app, and update any shortcuts or references that use the old path.

todos.name: EAS + store accounts (Balance mobile)
todos.howTo: Create an Expo Application Services project, enroll in the Apple Developer Program and Google Play Console, and configure the first EAS build for Balance mobile.

todos.name: Hermes webhook automation + config webhookUrl
todos.blockedOn: User must create the Cursor Automation webhook trigger, copy its URL, and run Hermes-Bridge/setup-webhook.ps1
todos.notes: Code side ready. Agent cannot create/save the user webhook without the secret URL.
todos.howTo: Create a Cursor Automation webhook trigger in Cursor settings, copy the webhook URL, and run Hermes-Bridge/setup-webhook.ps1 with that URL to finish the bridge.
